_comment: One source for what each project tab is FOR. Rendered on the dashboard (the line under the tab bar, the 'What each tab is for' panel) and in project_guide()'s 'The dashboard, tab by tab'. Edit here only; tests/test_tab_roles.py checks both renderings and that every tool named exists.

tabs.label: Paper
tabs.role: The manuscript and everything a journal receives with it: sections, figures, tables, references, reviews, exports, submissions.
tabs.holds: manuscript text, inline comments, the review and revision record, rendered exports
tabs.not: source files the paper cites (Materials); explainers for people (Study)

tabs.label: Presentation
tabs.role: Talks built from a paper: decks that reuse its figures and claims, rendered and exportable.
tabs.holds: decks, their slides, comments on slides
tabs.not: the paper's own figures (they stay in Paper; a deck references them)

tabs.label: Runs
tabs.role: Every computation behind a number: which machine, which command, which params, live status. The provenance a reviewer asks for.
tabs.holds: analysis runs across all papers, running or finished, with logs
tabs.not: the analyses' outputs themselves (they become figures/tables in Paper)

tabs.label: Activity
tabs.role: The shared checklist and timeline: what is planned, what happened, by whom.
tabs.holds: to-dos and a reverse-chronological feed of writes and milestones

tabs.label: Memory
tabs.role: Soft knowledge that is not in the data: preferences, why a decision was made, dead ends. Standing context for every session.
tabs.holds: one markdown document of durable notes, plus the project's playbook
tabs.not: machines and environments (the Servers registry); files (Materials); facts recoverable from the paper

tabs.label: Discussion
tabs.role: Where the argument is drawn and settled: graphs of the reasoning, threads, and the record of what was decided.
tabs.holds: drawn graphs (saved as data), discussion threads, decisions
tabs.not: the polished write-up (Study) or the manuscript (Paper)

tabs.label: Study
tabs.role: Explainers a person reads here, written against the project's numbers so they say when those numbers have moved.
tabs.holds: designed HTML documents with their data sources declared

tabs.label: Materials
tabs.role: Source files the paper refers to: PDFs to read, prior drafts, notes, data files. Traceability, not reading.
tabs.holds: uploaded files with the user's note and the agent's note
tabs.not: cited works (References, in Paper); explainers (Study); large data on servers (Datasets)

tabs.label: Datasets
tabs.role: Which data is on which server, at what path, keyed how, and what it joins to. The map the analyses run against.
tabs.holds: dataset registrations pointing at server paths
tabs.not: the files themselves; the machines (Servers registry)

tabs.label: Published
tabs.role: Unlisted live links to a page: something currently open, with people behind it and a moment when it should be closed.
tabs.not: exports (files, in Paper); the archive of a paper (a DOI, not offered)

tabs.label: Video
tabs.role: Recordings edited, captioned, dubbed and published from the paper's material. Admin-only for now.

tabs.label: Feedback
tabs.role: Bugs and feature requests about the harness itself, triaged by the developer. The agent files here too, while working.
tabs.holds: reports with status and the developer's note
tabs.not: comments on the manuscript (those are reviews, in Paper)

tabs.label: Setup guide
tabs.role: Wiring a session to this project: the API key, the config and skills for Claude Code, Codex or Pi.
tabs.holds: the key, the per-host setup script and files
